h1a: Every dirty surface is a job.
h1b: We make it ring to you.
tagline: Pressure washing is won by whoever answers first — the caller is standing outside looking at the stain, phone in hand, and they book the first company that picks up. We turn this brand into a 20-line Smart-DID grid across Miami-Dade and Broward where every roof, driveway, storefront, and HOA call is answered instantly, in the caller's language, and routed to the nearest available crew.
demoNote: South Florida exterior-cleaning campaign · roof · driveway · commercial · HOA · 20-line pack · numbers pending assignment
insight: a pressure-washing job runs $250–$8,000+ — and the difference between a driveway and a full commercial contract is which line the caller dialed. These calls come in hot: someone is looking at mildew right now, calling three companies off a map, and hiring whoever answers. A phone number that just rings can't sort that. A Smart DID can.

pillars.p: A compliant dialer works property managers, HOA boards, and commercial plazas on their contract cycles — branded caller-ID, recordings, callbacks. You reach the decision-maker before the contract renews with someone else.
20 tracked lines + 24/7 AI answer + SMS. Every source measured, commercial calls prioritized, every missed call auto-called-back.
Calls, texts, booked jobs, ad spend and source — one live dashboard. You finally see which dollar produced which job.

commandCenter.h2: Your live command center — the whole operation on one screen
commandCenter.note: Every call feeds a real-time conduit your customized "second brain" analyzes on the fly — then you, or the AI, adjust the leads, script, offer, territory, or channel instantly and watch your P&L move. You run the crews — we make the phone ring.
